name: Technical Documentation
description: Produce accurate, task-oriented technical documentation from source and product behavior through examples, review, publishing, and maintenance ownership.

tasks.name: Define documentation scope
tasks.objective: Identify audiences, jobs-to-be-done, product/version scope, supported platforms, prerequisites, terminology, existing docs, known gaps, and maintenance owner.

tasks.name: Inspect authoritative sources
tasks.objective: Review implementation, schemas, APIs, configuration, tests, release notes, product behavior, and subject-matter input. Record version-specific facts and unresolved contradictions.

tasks.name: Design information architecture
tasks.objective: Organize concepts, tutorials, how-to guides, references, troubleshooting, migration, security/permissions, and examples around user tasks and discoverability.

tasks.name: Draft and verify content
tasks.objective: Write concise procedures and references with tested commands/code, expected outcomes, failure states, warnings, cross-links, accessibility text, and copy-paste-safe examples.

tasks.name: Run technical and editorial review
tasks.objective: Have responsible experts verify correctness and version scope; check terminology, examples, links, prerequisites, security implications, readability, duplication, and accessibility.

tasks.name: Publish and maintain
tasks.objective: Release versioned docs with change notes, feedback path, ownership, review cadence, deprecation/migration markers, analytics where appropriate, and stale-content triggers.
